text:
My heart is like a god without tongue,

mute it waits for the miracle,

I have loved much, every love was meager,

for every love I knew with want.


I have loved unto weeping, unto dying.

I loved unto hating, I loved unto madness,

but I await some nature-love

capable of renewing and redeeming me.


Love that fructifies my desert

and makes sensitive branches sprout from me,

I am a forest of living roots,

only the foliage tends to be dead.


Where is the one who encourages my desire?

Did the branches impoverish me in his eyes?

Vulgar obstacle, pale foliage

distinct from the faithful trunk that feeds it.


Where is the somber spirit

from whose opacity the flame may spring?

Ah, if he inflames my worlds with his love

I will be uncontainable as a river.


Where is the one who with his love will wrap me?

He must bring his great known truth...

Ice and more ice I gathered in life:

I need a sun to dissolve me.

translation.title: A Sun
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the heart as living roots waiting for a dissolving sun.
